description: This file implements the HealthcheckService class, which manages periodic health checks (pings) to servers, handles acknowledgments, and manages server state changes based on ping responses. It includes methods for sending pings, handling ping sent acknowledgments, receiving acknowledgments, and removing servers from monitoring.

classes.name: HealthcheckService
classes.description: A service class responsible for performing periodic health checks (pings) to servers, handling responses, and managing server states based on ping acknowledgments.

methods.name: HealthcheckService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the health check service with a session server manager, a timer factory, and a health check interval.

methods.name: ~HealthcheckService
methods.description: Destructor that cancels and resets the health check timer if active.

methods.name: onPingSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a ping has been sent to a server, verifying the ping ID and recording the server for monitoring.

methods.name: onAckReceived
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment reception from a server, verifying ping ID, removing the server from monitoring, and updating server state if acknowledgment indicates failure.

methods.name: onServerRemoved
methods.description: Removes a server from the monitoring list.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: Sends a ping to all remaining servers, handles timeout logging, clears the monitoring list, generates a new ping ID, and initiates the next ping cycle.
